faq.question: Which EV has lower indicative running cost?
faq.answer: We use catalog service-cost-per-km and resale confidence signals — verify with your nearest authorized service center.

faq.question: What is the top pick on this page?
faq.answer: Tata XT is currently highest on our low maintenance composite (score 74, medium confidence). This is not a universal "best EV" claim — review tradeoffs below.

faq.question: What is the ex-showroom price of Tata XT?
faq.answer: Indicative ex-showroom from catalog: ₹7.99 lakh. Confirm on-road price with a dealer in your city.
